tray.tooltip: Toskar is running in the background
tray.stopHint: Stop the local AI service and quit

lifecycle.backgroundMenuBar: Toskar is still running in the menu bar
lifecycle.backgroundTray: Toskar is still running in the system tray

conflict.title: Another copy of Toskar is running
conflict.message:
{{other}} is already running on this computer at the address this app needs ({{address}}), so this app can't start its own. The other one has its own models, chats, and settings.

Quit it and open this app again, or use the other one for now.
conflict.messageProcess:
{{other}} is already running on this computer at the address this app needs ({{address}}), so this app can't start its own. It isn't this app's service: it's process {{pid}}, {{command}}.

Stop it and start this app's own service?
conflict.programTitle: Another program is using Toskar's address
conflict.program:
Process {{pid}}, {{command}}, is using the address Toskar needs ({{address}}), so Toskar can't start.

Quit that program, then open Toskar again.
conflict.programUnknown:
Another program is using the address Toskar needs ({{address}}), so Toskar can't start.

Quit the program using it, then open Toskar again.
conflict.stopFailed: Toskar couldn't stop process {{pid}}. Quit it yourself, then open Toskar again.
conflict.startFailed: Toskar stopped the other service, but its own didn't start. Open Toskar again.
